slot.brief: Sequence: phenol to benzene via distillation with Zn, then Friedel–Crafts acylation or similar; identify intermediates and final product; may include Williamson or diazonium route for rigor.

stem: Phenol is converted successively using (i) Zn dust and heat, (ii) $\text{CH}_3\text{Cl}/\text{AlCl}_3$, (iii) NBS and $h\nu$, and (iv) $\text{CH}_3\text{ONa}$ in methanol. What is the major final product?

verdicts.working: Phenol is reduced to benzene by Zn/heat, methylated to toluene, and benzylic bromination gives benzyl bromide. CH₃ONa substitutes Br to form PhCH₂OCH₃.

working:
$\text{C}_6\text{H}_5\text{OH}\xrightarrow{\text{Zn},\Delta}\text{C}_6\text{H}_6\xrightarrow{\text{CH}_3\text{Cl}/\text{AlCl}_3}\text{C}_6\text{H}_5\text{CH}_3$; $\text{C}_6\text{H}_5\text{CH}_3\xrightarrow{\text{NBS},h\nu}\text{C}_6\text{H}_5\text{CH}_2\text{Br}\xrightarrow{\text{CH}_3\text{ONa}}\text{C}_6\text{H}_5\text{CH}_2\text{OCH}_3$.

Independent check: Phenol is reduced to benzene by Zn/heat, methylated to toluene, and benzylic bromination gives benzyl bromide. CH₃ONa substitutes Br to form PhCH₂OCH₃.
solution:
Zn dust and heat reduce phenol to benzene; Friedel–Crafts methylation gives toluene. NBS and $h\nu$ brominate the benzylic position, followed by substitution with methoxide:
$$\text{C}_6\text{H}_5\text{CH}_3 \rightarrow \text{C}_6\text{H}_5\text{CH}_2\text{Br} \rightarrow \text{C}_6\text{H}_5\text{CH}_2\text{OCH}_3$$
The final product is benzyl methyl ether.
